_comment: PDK registry — phase3_one_shot_runner consults this for site / metal_prefix / clock-buffer / DRC-deck conventions per PDK. Third-party PDK plugins append entries here.

pdks.name: sky130A
pdks._device_models_comment: Curated from the sky130_fd_pr (SkyWater open-source PDK) primitive-device cell library — the SPICE subckt model names a netlist X-line legally references. analog_netlist_pdk_check.py validates X-line model tokens carrying the `device_model_prefix` namespace against this set; a token in-namespace but not listed => UNKNOWN_PDK_MODEL (stray/typo). Tokens outside the namespace (user subckts) are not validated.

pdks.name: gf180mcuD
pdks._asset_glob_comment: Asset globs VERIFIED against the shipped container image (ghcr.io/vibeic/vibeic-eda:0.2.24). The prior values matched NOTHING: (a) the std-cell liberty ships under `lib/`, not `liberty/` — `liberty/` does not exist; (b) `techlef/*.tlef` matches three corner variants (__max/__min/__nom) and the deterministic sorted-first pick took `__max`, not the nominal deck; (c) `libs.tech/klayout/drc/gf180mcu.lydrc` does not exist — the real KLayout sign-off deck is `libs.tech/klayout/tech/drc/gf180mcu.drc`. The liberty corner is PINNED because `lib/*tt*.lib` matches three supply variants (1v80/3v30/5v00) and sorted-first would take 1v80, the wrong rail for this 5V (mcu7t5v0) library; tt_025C_5v00 is its nominal sign-off corner.
pdks._lvs_deck_comment: gf180mcuD DOES ship both sign-off LVS routes; both were declared absent, which made the LVS-capability report call this PDK LVS-incapable. Paths verified present in the shipped image: libs.tech/netgen/gf180mcuD_setup.tcl (netgen) and libs.tech/klayout/tech/lvs/gf180mcu.lvs (KLayout). Same defect class, same two directory conventions, as the ihp-sg13g2 entry below. NOTE the digital phase3 LVS route does NOT read this key — it builds the netgen setup path by convention (libs.tech/netgen/<pdk>_setup.tcl) and was already working; this key feeds the analog/PV availability report and the A5/A7 gates.
pdks._lefdef_layermap_comment: LEF/DEF -> GDS streamout layer map. `--pdk sky130A` and `--pdk nangate45` each resolve one (sky130A.map / FreePDK45.map) from their hardcoded named branches; every registry-resolved PDK needs the key, and gf180mcuD had none, so streamout fell back to the DEF reader's COMPACT numbering. The gf180mcu.drc sign-off deck reads the foundry numbers (verified in libs.tech/klayout/tech/gf180mcu.map: Metal1=34/0, Metal2=36/0, Metal3=42/0, Metal4=46/0, Metal5=81/0, Via1=35/0), so on compact numbering the routing and PDN shapes land on the deck's FEOL device numbers and the DRC report is a numbering artefact, not a design measurement — the nangate45 branch records 18.7M spurious FEOL items from exactly this cause. This is the same file gf180mcuD's own librelane config.tcl sets as KLAYOUT_DEF_LAYER_MAP.
pdks._pnr_exclude_comment: PnR cell-exclusion list. Absent => the flow falls back to a get_lib_cells family heuristic. gf180mcuD ships the real list at libs.tech/librelane/gf180mcu_fd_sc_mcu7t5v0/pnr_exclude.cells (verified present in the shipped image).
pdks._pdn_straps_comment: Upper-metal PDN mesh. Metal1 follow-pin rails ALONE leave the per-row rails electrically isolated, so OpenROAD PSM reports `Unconnected instance <inst>/VDD` then `[ERROR PSM-0069] Check connectivity failed on VDD` and static IR / EM cannot be computed at all (measured on ihp-sg13g2 before its straps were declared; the mechanism is PDK-independent). Values are taken VERBATIM from gf180mcuD's OWN libs.tech/librelane/config.tcl: PDN_VERTICAL_LAYER Metal4 / PDN_HORIZONTAL_LAYER Metal5, PDN_VWIDTH 1.6 PDN_VPITCH 153.6 PDN_VOFFSET 16.32, PDN_HWIDTH 1.6 PDN_HPITCH 153.18 PDN_HOFFSET 16.65, PDN_RAIL_LAYER Metal1. That file's PDN_RAIL_WIDTH 0.6 independently matches the follow-pin width this runner discovers from the cell LEF (VDD/VSS on Metal1, w=0.6), which cross-validates the source.
pdks._physical_cell_comment: Physical-cell masters read from the shipped LEF by their LEF CLASS, not by name shape: `gf180mcu_fd_sc_mcu7t5v0__filltie` is the library's only `CLASS core WELLTAP` and `gf180mcu_fd_sc_mcu7t5v0__antenna` its only `CLASS core ANTENNACELL`. Without tapcell_master the PnR step printed `TAPCELL_SKIPPED: no tapcell_master configured` and placed ZERO well taps, which is a categorical latch-up exposure. tapcell_distance_um 14.0 sits under the PDK's own 15um max-tap-distance rule for this 5V library — DF.13_MV and DF.14_MV in libs.tech/klayout/tech/drc/rule_decks/comp.rb both state 15um (the LV variants are 20um).
pdks._device_models_comment: Curated from the gf180mcu_fd_pr (GlobalFoundries 180nm MCU open-source PDK) primitive-device cell library. Both the bare (`nfet_03v3`) and fully-qualified (`gf180mcu_fd_pr__nfet_03v3`) forms are listed because real GF180 analog netlists call the device subckts by either name. device_model_prefix is empty-permissive for GF180: the program validates a token only when it matches one of the two GF180 device namespaces (bare `*fet_0*` / `*cap_*` / `*res_*` or `gf180mcu_fd_pr__*`).

pdks.name: ihp-sg13g2
pdks._deck_comment: IHP Open-PDK SG13G2 DOES ship both a KLayout DRC deck and sign-off LVS data; these were declared null, which made the DRC/LVS sign-off gates self-skip on a PDK that can actually run them. Paths verified present in vibeic-eda 0.2.24. The KLayout deck lives under libs.tech/klayout/tech/drc/ (NOT the libs.tech/klayout/drc/ layout sky130A/gf180/nangate45/asap7 use) and is a plain .drc, not a .lydrc — so a path convention assuming <pdk>/libs.tech/klayout/drc/<pdk>.lydrc cannot find it.
pdks._tapcell_comment: SG13G2 ships NO tapcell/well-tie master (the 84 stdcell MACROs include sg13g2_tiehi/sg13g2_tielo signal tie cells and sg13g2_fill_*/sg13g2_decap_*, but no tap master). This is BY DESIGN and confirmed upstream twice: the PDK's own libs.tech/librelane/sg13g2_stdcell/config.tcl says 'There are no endcap and welltie cells in ihp-sg13g2 thus set to undefined to skip insertion' (WELLTAP_CELL/ENDCAP_CELL both commented out), and the OpenROAD-flow-scripts ihp-sg13g2 platform's tapcell.tcl contains only 'cut_rows' with no tapcell call. Well/substrate ties are INTERNAL to every std cell. tapcell_master=null makes the tapcell step self-skip with a disclosed NONFATAL, which is correct for this PDK rather than a hard failure.
pdks._tap_geom_comment: FEOL layer numbers for the tapless-cell latch-up VERIFICATION (PERC geometry layer), taken from the PDK's own DRC deck libs.tech/klayout/tech/drc/rule_decks/layers_def.drc: activ_drw=(1,0), gatpoly_drw=(5,0), psd_drw=(14,0), nwell_drw=(31,0). SG13G2 draws ONLY the p-type implant: nsd_drw=(7,0) exists in the deck but is EMPTY in a std-cell layout (measured 0 polygons on a signed-off spm GDS vs 3961 pSD), because N+ is implied wherever Activ is not covered by pSD. Hence implicit_implant=nplus, derived as (activ - pplus). With this the tap measurement finds real ties (measured: 20 N-well tap regions / 936.8um2 and 21 P-substrate tap regions / 1091.7um2) and the latch-up screen resolves to TAPLESS_CELL_INTERNAL_TIES instead of a false-positive FAIL.
pdks._pdn_straps_comment: Upper-metal PDN mesh. Metal1 follow-pin rails ALONE leave the per-row rails electrically isolated from each other: OpenROAD PSM then reports hundreds of 'PSM-0039 Unconnected instance <inst>/VDD' followed by '[ERROR PSM-0069] Check connectivity failed on VDD', so static IR and EM cannot be computed and the IR-Drop / EM sign-off steps produce no report at all. Values are taken VERBATIM from the OpenROAD-flow-scripts ihp-sg13g2 platform pdn.tcl (TopMetal1/TopMetal2 stripes width 2.200, pitch 75.6, offset 13.600; connects Metal1->TopMetal1->TopMetal2); that file's Metal1 follow-pin width 0.44 independently matches the width this runner discovers from the cell LEF, which cross-validates the source.
pdks._device_map_comment: R13 (analog A4) — per-PDK GENERIC->FOUNDRY device map. `device_map` is a PDK-AGNOSTIC schema field: keys are generic role tokens (nmos/pmos/nmos_hv/pmos_hv/res_poly/cap_mim/npn/...) that a corner-sweep deck template refers to abstractly; values are the REAL foundry primitive-device model names for THIS PDK. A corner sweep that must instantiate a device for `nmos` looks it up here instead of hardcoding a foundry token, so the SAME template drives any populated PDK. Read via programs/pdk_device_map.py. This ihp-sg13g2 entry is populated with the real IHP Open-PDK SG13G2 PSP primitive-device names; sky130A / gf180mcuD keep their existing `device_models` unchanged (no `device_map` required). `device_models` here is the flat set of legal SG13G2 model tokens (the union of the map values), matching the sky130/gf180 shape.

analog_device_params.note: lv nfet/pfet typical Vth (HV sg13_hv_* available). Core supply is 1.2V, NOT 1.8V: the shipped Liberty sg13g2_stdcell_typ_1p20V_25C.lib declares nom_voltage : 1.2, and the corner set is 1p08/1p20/1p32 (LV) plus 1p35/1p50/1p65 (the elevated-VDD characterisation). The previous 1.8 was carried over from the sky130 entry and would mis-bias any analog sizing done against this PDK.

pdks.name: ihp-sg13cmos5l
pdks._entry_comment: IHP Open-PDK SG13CMOS5L — the CMOS-only sibling of ihp-sg13g2, shipped complete in vibeic-eda (verified in 0.2.30: 6 std-cell Liberty corners, tech LEF, cell LEF, cell GDS, KLayout DRC deck, netgen + KLayout LVS decks, LEF/DEF layermap). It was SHIPPED-BUT-UNREGISTERED, which is why it needed this entry: with no entry, `--pdk ihp-sg13cmos5l` resolved to something else entirely (see vibe-ic#389; vibe-ic#392 then made such a name FAIL instead of silently substituting, which is why registering it is what actually makes it selectable). Every value below is read from the PDK's OWN files inside the pinned image, NOT copied from the sg13g2 entry — the two PDKs differ in ways a copy would get wrong (see _stack_comment). Upstream maturity caveat, quoted from the PDK's own README.md: 'This repo is meant to be used only as a temporary storage during the development of the build/compile migration script for the sg13 cmos5l PDK.' — so treat sign-off numbers from it as provisional on the upstream drop, not on this entry.
pdks._stack_comment: DIVERGENCE FROM THE SIBLING — do not copy sg13g2's geometry here. sg13cmos5l is an M1-M4-TM1 stack; its own tech LEF header says 'Removed: Via4, Metal5, TopVia2, TopMetal2'. sg13g2 is M1-M5-TM1-TM2. The routing DIRECTIONs also differ at the top: sg13cmos5l TopMetal1 is HORIZONTAL (same axis as the Metal1 follow-pin rails), whereas sg13g2 TopMetal1 is VERTICAL. Consequences: (a) any PDN plan naming TopMetal2 references a layer this PDK does not have; (b) a TopMetal1-only strap plan would run PARALLEL to the rails and bond nothing. So this entry deliberately declares NO `pdn_straps` — `_auto_pdn_straps_from_techlef` derives the alternating chain rails(Metal1,H) -> Metal4(V) -> TopMetal1(H) from this PDK's own LEF DIRECTIONs, which is correct here and stays correct if upstream changes the stack. Declare `pdn_straps` only if a measured IR/EM result shows the derived grid is inadequate.
pdks._clk_buf_comment: Taken from the PDK's OWN libs.tech/librelane/sg13cmos5l_stdcell/config.tcl: CTS_ROOT_BUFFER=sg13cmos5l_buf_8 and CTS_CLK_BUFFERS='sg13cmos5l_buf_8 buf_4 buf_2 buf_1'. NOTE this is NOT the sibling's choice (sg13g2 uses buf_4/buf_16) — sg13cmos5l's library tops out its CTS buffer list at buf_8, so copying the sibling's root buffer would name a cell outside this PDK's declared CTS set.
pdks._tapcell_comment: SG13CMOS5L ships NO tapcell/well-tie master, exactly as its sg13g2 sibling does. Confirmed from the PDK's own libs.tech/librelane/sg13cmos5l_stdcell/config.tcl, which says verbatim 'There are no endcap and welltie cells in ihp-sg13cmos5l thus set to undefined to skip insertion' with WELLTAP_CELL and ENDCAP_CELL both commented out. Independently corroborated by scanning the cell LEF: 84 MACROs, of which the only tie-like cells are the sg13cmos5l_tiehi / sg13cmos5l_tielo SIGNAL tie cells plus sg13cmos5l_fill_* / sg13cmos5l_decap_* — no tap master. Well/substrate ties are INTERNAL to every std cell. tapcell_master=null makes the tapcell step self-skip with a disclosed NONFATAL, which is correct for this PDK rather than a hard failure.
pdks._tap_geom_comment: FEOL layer numbers for the tapless-cell latch-up VERIFICATION (PERC geometry layer). WHAT THESE KEYS BUY, stated as MEASURED on this tree rather than from the sibling's history: `tapcell_master` being null routes the latch-up screen into the tapless branch (`elif pdk.tapcell_master is None`), which calls _measure_tap_geometry. WITHOUT tap_geom_layers that call returns ok=False ('tap_geom_layers missing nwell/nplus/pplus GDS layers') and the category lands on status=MANUAL_REVIEW / result=INCOMPLETE / welltap_status=WELLTAP_TAPLESS_INDETERMINATE — never a fabricated PASS, but also never an automated sign-off. WITH them the screen can measure the cell-internal ties and resolve to AUTOMATED PASS (WELLTAP_PRESENT_BY_GEOMETRY). NOTE: the older 'false-positive FAIL' framing describes the DEF-COMPONENT path (0 tap COMPONENTS on a tapless PDK read as ZERO_TAPS), which is what the ihp-sg13g2 fix removed by adding the tapless branch; that branch is already in the tree, so what is at stake for THIS entry is INDETERMINATE-vs-verified, not FAIL-vs-PASS. Numbers read from THIS PDK's own KLayout deck, not inherited from the sibling: activ_drw=(1,0), gatpoly_drw=(5,0), psd_drw=(14,0), nwell_drw=(31,0). They happen to match sg13g2's, which is expected for the same SG13 process family, but they were re-read here rather than assumed. NOTE THE DELIBERATE ABSENCE OF AN `nplus` KEY. This PDK's decks DO name 7/0 as the N+ implant (`nSD = input(7,0)` in the DRC deck, `nSD = source.polygons("7/0")` in the LVS deck), but the deck itself derives N+ active WITHOUT it — `nactiv = activ_drw.not(psd_drw.join(nsd_block))` — and MEASURED on this PDK's own shipped std-cell GDS (libs.ref/sg13cmos5l_stdcell/gds/sg13cmos5l_stdcell.gds, via KLayout): layer 7/0 is ABSENT FROM THE FILE ENTIRELY, while activ=475, gatpoly=453, psd=172 and nwell=86 shapes are present. So the only correct encoding is implicit_implant=nplus, derived as (activ - pplus). An entry that declared an explicit nplus=7/0 INSTEAD of implicit_implant would satisfy the (nwell AND nplus AND pplus) gate, then measure ntap=(7/0 AND nwell)-poly = EMPTY and report a conclusive WELLTAP_GEOMETRY_ABSENT FAIL — a false positive aimed at geometry this library never draws.
pdks._analog_comment: Analog keys (device_map / device_models / analog_device_params) are deliberately ABSENT. This entry was added to make DIGITAL sign-off resolve to the right PDK; no analog corner sweep has been run against sg13cmos5l's SPICE models, and its libs.tech/ngspice/models tree mixes sg13cmos5l_*-named and sg13g2_*-named model files, so a device map copied from the sibling could name models this PDK does not define. An absent map makes the analog programs report 'no device map for this PDK' — the honest state — rather than silently sweeping with wrong device names. Populate it only from a measured ngspice run against this PDK.

pdks.name: nangate45
pdks._comment: NanGate / FreePDK45 Open Cell Library (Si2, Apache-2.0; based on NCSU FreePDK45). A GENERIC, NON-FOUNDRY 45nm standard-cell library: full LEF + Liberty + GDS, so synth / floorplan / PnR / CTS / STA / area-timing estimation all run (this is the same enablement the open 45nm flows use). The KLayout FreePDK45 DRC deck (FreePDK45.lydrc) is an EDUCATIONAL rule-check, NOT a manufacturable foundry sign-off; a CDL source netlist ships for structural LVS but there is NO KLayout LVS deck (lvs_deck=null). tapeout_capable=false: FreePDK45 is a fictional process with no real foundry, no manufacturable GDS layer stack, and no foundry sign-off — use it for learning, RTL-to-GDS flow bring-up, and area/timing benchmarking, never for production silicon. Container assets are the OpenROAD-flow-scripts nangate45 platform (v3.0), re-staged into the open_pdks-style libs.ref/<scl>/ layout the resolvers expect (see vibeic-eda Dockerfile).

pdks.name: asap7
pdks._comment: ASAP7 — the ASU/ARM 7nm PREDICTIVE academic PDK (BSD-3-Clause). A realistic but GENERIC, NON-FOUNDRY 7nm FinFET standard-cell library (`asap7sc7p5t`, 7.5-track): full LEF + Liberty + GDS, so synth / floorplan / PnR / CTS / STA / area-timing estimation all run at a 7nm-representative node. The KLayout asap7 DRC deck (asap7.lydrc, BSD-2-Clause) is an EDUCATIONAL rule-check, NOT a manufacturable foundry sign-off; no KLayout/netgen LVS deck ships (lvs_deck=null; see _lvs_deck_comment for the B1/#174 device-LVS defer rationale). B2/#175: the ORFS OpenRCX extraction model (rcx_patterns.rules) now ships (vibeic-eda >=0.2.24) at rcx_rules below, so post-route SPEF extracts against a real per-layer RC model (single typical corner; see _rcx_rules_comment). tapeout_capable=false: ASAP7 is a predictive process with no real foundry, no manufacturable layer stack, and no foundry sign-off, and its drawn geometry uses a 4x-scaled convention — use it for learning, RTL-to-GDS flow bring-up at 7nm, and area/timing benchmarking, never for production silicon. Assets are the OpenROAD-flow-scripts asap7 platform (v3.0): the DEFAULT RVT (R) VT flavor at the TYPICAL (TT) corner, re-staged into the open_pdks-style libs.ref/<scl>/ layout the resolvers expect (see vibeic-eda Dockerfile). ASAP7 splits Liberty into 5 functional groups (AO / INVBUF / OA / SEQ / SIMPLE), so liberty_glob matches the RVT-TT set rather than a single monolithic .lib.
pdks._rcx_rules_comment: B2/#175 — the ORFS asap7 OpenRCX extraction model (rcx_patterns.rules, header 'Extraction Rules for OpenRCX') is staged in the image at this path (vibeic-eda >=0.2.24). phase3_one_shot_runner._emit_spef resolves the captable via its libs.tech/{librelane,openlane}/rules.openrcx.*.nom[.magic] glob (derived from tech_lef root), so post-route SPEF EXTRACTS against a real per-layer RC model rather than the tech-LEF-RC fallback. This field RECORDS the staged asset for that glob (single typical corner only → nom; min/max disclosed absent).
pdks._lvs_deck_comment: B1/#174 — device-level LVS on asap7 is now REACHABLE (both former blockers retired; vibeic-eda >=0.2.25). (1) The transistor-level GOLDEN exists and is PUBLIC/BSD-3: the ASAP7 std-cell CDL (asap7sc7p5t_28), one .SUBCKT per cell with 4-terminal FinFETs (nmos_rvt/pmos_rvt, nfin=N), staged at cdl_netlist below. (2) FinFET recognition needs no FinFET-native extractor: KLayout's planar DeviceExtractorMOS3Transistor recognizes the ASAP7 device GEOMETRICALLY (GATE poly crossing ACTIVE, N/P split by the NSELECT/PSELECT implant markers); the ASAP7-specific unlock is subtracting GATE_CUT (10/0), which electrically severs the full-height drawn poly into the active gate plus rail-tied stubs (without it, connect(gate,LIG) welds the gate to the VDD/VSS rail straps = a false short). programs/asap7_finfet_lvs.py does the extract + reuses klayout_pdk_lvs's NetlistComparer path. VERIFIED on the asap7sc7p5t_28 R library: 159/208 (76%) device-level MATCH, proven-negative confirmed (one-net corrupt -> MISMATCH). The 49-cell residual is a DISCLOSED, well-understood LVS-hard case (folded multi-finger drive cells: the layout draws a golden nfin=N device as M parallel series-stacks with independent internal diffusion nodes — electrically equivalent, topologically distinct, needing series-parallel device reduction NetlistComparer does not perform; NEVER reported as MATCH). lvs_deck stays null because this is NOT a netgen setup TCL — the deck is the geometric KLayout path (klayout_lvs_tech below). LEC (yosys) still covers RTL<->gate equivalence. ASAP7 is predictive (tapeout_capable=false) — a MATCH is never silicon-proven. See vibeic-eda FIX_STATUS.md (Tool 3 klayout, B1 row).
pdks._spice_models_comment: BSIM-CMG (level 72) FinFET device models, TT corner (SS/FF also staged in libs.tech/hspice/). Model tokens nmos_rvt/pmos_rvt/*_lvt/*_slvt/*_sram — the same names the CDL golden M-cards reference.

pdks.name: custom_auto_detect
pdks._comment: Generic placeholder — phase3_one_shot_runner.py auto-detects site/metal_prefix/clk_buf from project's input/pdk/ when no named PDK matches. This entry just documents the auto-detect heuristics.
pdks.metal_prefix: (auto from tech LEF first ROUTING layer)
pdks.clk_buf_cell: (auto: scan liberty for CLKBUF / BUF cells)
